      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "flattening coins into two arrays and converting them into an ephemeral map requires two full copies of the UTXO set and will not scale to production",
      "quote": "While this approach may serve as a proof-of-concept, it will not scale to a production application.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author switched to callback approach for fetching coins in push 5c65fc94a3",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5204246251"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5204246251",
      "status_by_quote": "Switched to callback approach for fetching the coins"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5204427745",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "a caller-supplied lookup callback allows non-deterministic lookups across calls and fails to capture the resulting UTXO set changes",
      "quote": "I think we should control the container ourselves, rather than using a lookup(outpoint) -> coin callback that the caller provides so that we can be sure the lookups are consistent across calls.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "contested",
      "status_note": "purpleKarrot questioned consistency concerns; ajtowns pushed back citing non-deterministic lookup breakage",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [
        "c:5206112218",
        "c:5266904750"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5248648596",
      "status_by_quote": "A `lookup(outpoint)` function can return `(randbool() ? coin1 : coin2)` to break our logic, or do something equivalent by accident."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3970483852",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "ancestor blocks under assumevalid will skip script checks during validation instead of running full validation",
      "quote": "When we call `ConnectBlock` on a main chain block that is an ancestor of the `assumevalid` block (and satisfies some other straightforward criteria), we inherit `assumevalid` logic and omit script checks.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5824099852",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "ValidateBlock caches successful script checks in m_script_execution_cache without committing to the spent coins, allowing caller-supplied forged coins to validate and later cause the node to connect an invalid block",
      "quote": "ValidateBlock() can make the node connect an invalid block.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "contested",
      "status_note": "author suggested clearing the cache; w0xlt pushed back that populated cache hits still occur, and proposed bypassing script cache",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5829114150"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "c:5843565249"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5836264573",
      "status_by_quote": "the solution suggested above also needs refinement: it prevents new entries from being stored, but still allows hits from an already populated cache"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5824444513",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "ValidateBlock can crash on an assertion failure in release builds when validating a transaction with a BIP68 relative lock if a caller-supplied coin has a confirmation height at or above the block height",
      "quote": "ValidateBlock() can crash on a coin with an impossible confirmation height.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "contested",
      "status_note": "author suggested documenting the height requirement; w0xlt pushed back that documenting still leaves an avoidable crash",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5829114150"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "c:5843565249"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5836264573",
      "status_by_quote": "Just documenting the height requirement still leaves an avoidable crash."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:4358034862",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "whether the goal of this endeavor is to retire btck_block_spent_outputs_read from the kernel",
      "quote": "The goal of this endeavor is to retire `btck_block_spent_outputs_read` from the kernel?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author clarified that retiring btck_block_spent_outputs_read is unrelated",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:4358092263"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:4358092263",
      "status_by_quote": "No, I think that is unrelated."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:4358903754",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "pass spent coins directly instead of requiring the caller to construct and pass block undo data",
      "quote": "won't it be more straightforward to just pass the spent coins and add them to the coins cache",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author agreed and updated PR to pass spent coins directly",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:4359568454"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:4967070306",
      "status_by_quote": "Basically went with @ismaelsadeeq's suggestion of passing in two arrays encoding pairs of outpoints and coins."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:4383686798",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "pass a coin getter callback to the validate block function instead of arrays",
      "quote": "the callback passed to the validate method makes sense to me",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author adopted the callback approach in push 5c65fc94a3",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5204246251",
      "status_by_quote": "Switched to callback approach for fetching the coins"
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5111242699",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "add a direct (non-kernel) test for ValidateBlock in validation.cpp",
      "quote": "I think there should be a direct (non-kernel) test for the new `ValidateBlock` (in `validation.cpp`).",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    }
  ],

    {

  ],
